project.name: RouteMate
project.purpose: RouteMate provides an online platform where passengers can find and book available seats in cars traveling from one city to another, drivers can publish and manage verified intercity rides, and admins can manage users, driver verification, rides, bookings, and reports.

actors.description: A normal user who searches for rides, books available seats, tracks booking status, and manages their profile.
A service provider who submits identity verification, creates rides after approval, manages own rides, and accepts or rejects booking requests.
A platform manager who controls user access, driver verification, ride moderation, booking oversight, and reports.

structure.api: Fetch API helper functions for backend communication
structure.components: Reusable UI components such as Navbar, Sidebar, ProtectedRoute, RoleBasedRoute, StatCard, RideCard, DataTable, SearchBar, FilterDropdown, ConfirmDialog, and Loader
structure.context: AuthContext for token, user, login, register, logout, profile update, and session refresh
structure.pages: Public, passenger, driver, and admin page groups

global: AuthContext stores user, token, loading state, login, register, logout, refreshUser, and updateProfile

styling.customStyles: client/src/styles.css contains project branding and layout overrides

middleware.protect: Verifies JWT token and attaches authenticated user to req.user

indexes: Unique index on ride + passenger to prevent duplicate bookings

businessLogic: Only passengers can practically request bookings through the passenger UI.
Drivers cannot book their own rides.
Drivers must be verified before creating or editing rides.
Drivers can only manage their own rides and related booking requests.
Admins can manage users, drivers, rides, bookings, and reports.
Accepting a booking reduces available ride seats by one.
Changing an accepted booking away from accepted restores one seat.
Deleting an accepted booking restores one seat.
Deleting a ride also deletes related bookings.
Deleting a user also deletes related rides and bookings.
